ArithmeticGaloisRepresentations.summary: The libraries have general carriers but none of the arithmetic theory. Mathlib has continuous representations (ContRepresentation, TopRep, with restriction and coinduction), the Krull-topologised absolute Galois group with continuous restriction along field embeddings, the cyclotomic character, arithmetic Frobenius elements, Weierstrass reduction types and point-count local L-factors. Tau Ceti adds integral Galois lattices with the open-kernel and finite-quotient factorisation, continuous Hom representations over normed fields, algebraic exterior and symmetric powers and base change, finite-group character determination in characteristic zero, GL2(F_q) conjugacy and torus structure, abelian varieties with [n] and isogenies, #ker[n] = n^2 for elliptic curves, and infrastructure (but not the theorem) for Chebotarev. Genuinely missing: invariant lattices, residual semisimplification and characteristic-p Brauer-Nesbitt, Weil groups, tame and fundamental characters, Grothendieck monodromy and Weil-Deligne representations, Artin and Swan conductors, finite-subgroup classification of PGL2 and absolute irreducibility, Chebotarev recognition and coefficient descent, polarizations, adequacy and enormous image, and the Tate module with its Weil-pairing determinant and Frobenius polynomial.

targets.target: Finite projective coefficient modules with continuous actions as the common carrier, with framed coordinates
targets.note: Only the general carrier (continuity of each operator) exists; no finite projective specialisation or framing.

targets.target: Exterior and symmetric powers, tensor induction and restriction of scalars with continuity and characteristic-polynomial identities
targets.note: Exterior and symmetric powers exist algebraically only; tensor induction, restriction of scalars of representations, continuity and characteristic-polynomial identities are absent.

targets.target: Polarizations r^c = r^dual tensor mu for CM fields with pairing and multiplier; symmetry sign, determinant constraints, twisting and extension
targets.note: CM fields with complex conjugation and invariant bilinear forms exist; no polarized Galois representation.

targets.target: Oddness of polarized representations via signs at real places
targets.note: Absent.

targets.target: Adequacy and enormous image (ACC+ Definition 6.2.29) with verification lemmas and coefficient-extension invariance (Lemma 6.2.30)
targets.note: Group cohomology H^0 and H^1 exist, but no adequate or enormous subgroup, regular semisimple element or Taylor-Wiles image condition.

targets.target: Adjoint and trace-zero adjoint representations, the quotient by scalars, and the correction when p divides n
targets.note: linHom rho rho is the adjoint action on End(V); the trace-zero subrepresentation, the quotient by scalars and the p | n analysis are absent.

targets.target: Transfer of polynomial-law data to an actual representation
targets.note: Only the basic polynomial-law module; no determinants or reconstruction.

duplicates.note: Restates tensor products, duals, symmetric and exterior powers, induction and restriction for rank-n and polarized systems, importing this layer for the representation-level operations.
Owns the algebraic symmetric and exterior power representations, already built in Tau Ceti.

targets.target: Continuous representations of a profinite group on finite projective coefficient modules of arbitrary rank, with field and finite-free local-ring specialisations
targets.note: Mathlib's ContRepresentation is a monoid hom G ->* (V ->L[R] V) over any ring, but it only asks each g to act continuously, not joint continuity in g; Tau Ceti's Galois lattices are finite free Z-modules with open stabilisers. Nothing specialises to finite projective modules over complete local rings or finite extensions of Q_p with joint continuity.

targets.target: Existence of a Galois-stable lattice in a continuous representation over a p-adic field, by compactness
targets.note: No invariant-lattice or compact-group stable-open-submodule theorem was found in either library.

targets.target: Descent of a continuous representation into GL2 of an algebraic closure of F_p (discrete topology) to a finite coefficient field
targets.note: Only the finiteness of the quotient by an open subgroup exists; the finite-image and finite-subfield descent argument is absent.

targets.target: Finite Galois factorisation versus continuity for finite coefficients
targets.note: Tau Ceti proves open stabilisers imply an open kernel for any finite module, and that the action then factors through a finite (separable) Galois quotient, but only packages the factorisation for Z-lattices; the converse and the stated equivalence for finite coefficient rings are not recorded.

targets.target: Reduction of a lattice followed by semisimplification, and independence of the lattice via characteristic polynomials and characteristic-p Brauer-Nesbitt
targets.note: Only finite groups in characteristic zero are determined by characters, plus semisimple-module reconstruction from Hom dimensions and Jordan-Holder coordinates; no text or declaration mentions Brauer-Nesbitt and there is no semisimplification of a reduction.

targets.target: Restriction, induction, duals, twists and coefficient extension with topology on every map
targets.note: Continuous restriction and coinduction (on continuous functions) are in Mathlib; Tau Ceti's continuous Hom representation over a normed field gives duals with continuity (continuous_linHom); base change, twists by characters and induction exist only algebraically, without topology.

duplicates.note: Proves reconstruction of representations over algebraically closed fields up to semisimplification, the determinant form of the Brauer-Nesbitt step here.

targets.target: Restriction to a decomposition group through a place or an embedding into a local separable closure, with independence of the choice up to conjugacy
targets.note: Mathlib gives a continuous map of absolute Galois groups from a field embedding (for example K into its completion), explicitly depending on a chosen embedding of algebraic closures; conjugacy independence is not proved. Decomposition and inertia subgroups exist only for finite Galois extensions.

targets.target: Tame characters and fundamental characters of levels one and two
targets.note: Neither library has tame inertia, the tame quotient or the characters sigma -> sigma(pi^(1/m))/pi^(1/m); only the Teichmuller lift and the cyclotomic character exist.

targets.target: Grothendieck quasi-unipotence of inertia for l different from the residue characteristic
targets.note: No monodromy theorem or quasi-unipotence statement in either library.

targets.target: Monodromy operator and Weil-Deligne representation, independent of the tame character, with rho(F) N rho(F)^-1 = qN for arithmetic Frobenius
targets.note: No Weil group, Weil-Deligne representation or monodromy operator in either library.

targets.target: Semisimplification and Frobenius semisimplification of a Weil-Deligne representation
targets.note: Only additive Jordan-Chevalley decomposition over perfect fields and multiplicative Jordan decomposition of algebraic-group points exist, the linear algebra behind Frobenius semisimplification.

duplicates.note: Constructs inertia, wild inertia, Frobenius lifts and the tame character I_K/P_K = Z^(p')(1) with independence of choices, the tame and fundamental characters asked for here.
Constructs the tame character t_l, the monodromy operator N with independence of the tame generator and quasi-unipotence, in the geometric setting.

targets.target: Artin and Swan conductors from the ramification filtration, independent of the finite quotient and auxiliary choices
targets.note: Lower-numbering ramification groups exist only for places of function fields trivial on a constant field (not p-adic fields), Mathlib's higher ramification groups are a TODO, there is no upper numbering, and the only conductors are those of Dirichlet characters and ring-theoretic conductors.

targets.target: Integrality of the conductors and induction and twist formulas
targets.note: No Hasse-Arf, Artin character or conductor-discriminant formula.

targets.target: Conductor of an l-adic representation with the monodromy term, and of a residual representation through its finite inertia action; N(rho-bar) as prime-to-p conductor
targets.note: Absent; there are no Weil-Deligne representations to attach it to.

targets.target: Reduction does not increase the conductor at primes different from p
targets.note: Absent.

targets.target: Comparison with the conductor of an elliptic curve, including wild contributions at 2 and 3
targets.note: Mathlib classifies good, multiplicative and additive reduction of a minimal Weierstrass model, but defines no conductor exponent, Tate's algorithm or Ogg formula.

duplicates.note: Defines conductor exponents of abelian characters of local fields, the one-dimensional case of the Artin conductor.
Proves Artin conductor formulas for rank-two Weil-Deligne parameters in explicit GL2 coordinates.

targets.target: Finite subgroups of GL2 and PGL2 over finite fields: dihedral and exceptional images, normal subgroups, restriction to cyclotomic fields
targets.note: Tau Ceti has GL2(F) conjugacy classes, the Borel and non-split torus, but no Dickson classification of subgroups of PGL2(F_q) and no image analysis.

targets.target: For odd p, an odd irreducible two-dimensional representation over a finite field is absolutely irreducible; the characteristic-two case isolated
targets.note: Irreducibility exists but absolute irreducibility, oddness and this lemma do not.

targets.target: Bad-dihedral representations in the source's sense
targets.note: Absent.

targets.target: Chebotarev recognition: semisimple continuous characteristic-zero or residual representations with equal Frobenius characteristic polynomials are isomorphic, after a common coefficient extension
targets.note: Tau Ceti has the Frobenius prime sets and counting weights of the Chebotarev argument but not the density theorem, and character determination only for finite groups in characteristic zero; Brauer-Nesbitt is absent.

targets.target: Coefficient descent of a trace-and-determinant system defined over a subfield when the descent obstruction vanishes
targets.note: Only semilinear Galois descent of vector spaces and the real-realizability criterion for compact groups exist; no Schur-index or Brauer-class obstruction for descending representations.

targets.target: Arithmetic continuity and Frobenius density comparisons for determinant laws and representations
targets.note: Density of Frobenius elements is not proved, and Mathlib's polynomial laws have only their basic module structure (no multiplicative laws or determinants).

duplicates.note: Proves uniqueness of determinants from Frobenius density using Chebotarev and continuity, the recognition statement in determinant form.
Proves reconstruction of semisimple representations from determinants over algebraically closed fields.

targets.target: Tate module as the inverse limit of l-power torsion of an elliptic curve or abelian variety
targets.note: Only #ker[n] = n^2 over an algebraically closed field with n invertible and the endomorphism [n] of an abelian variety exist; E[n] = (Z/n)^2 and the inverse system are absent.

targets.target: Comparison of the residual representation with the existing pointwise Galois action on torsion points
targets.note: Points are functorial along algebra maps (so automorphisms act), but no Galois representation on E[l] is packaged.

targets.target: Rank 2 (2g) and continuity of the l-adic representation
targets.note: Absent.

targets.target: Weil-pairing determinant equal to the cyclotomic character, and oddness over Q
targets.note: The Weil pairing is not constructed (Tau Ceti has only divisor-calculus preparation).

targets.target: Good-reduction Frobenius characteristic polynomial X^2 - a_p X + p on the Tate module
targets.note: Only a_q = q + 1 - #E(F_q) and deg(1 - Frobenius) = #E(F_q) exist; the Hasse bound and the action of Frobenius on T_l are absent.

targets.target: Compatibility of Tate modules with isogenies
targets.note: Isogenies of abelian varieties and elliptic curves exist, but no induced map on Tate modules.

targets.target: Conductor comparison and local Euler-polynomial interface
targets.note: Mathlib defines local polynomials of a Weierstrass curve over a DVR from point counts and reduction type, not from inertia invariants of a Tate module; no conductor and no comparison theorem.

duplicates.note: Constructs E[N] = (Z/N)^2, the Weil pairing, the Tate module with its continuous Galois representation and det = cyclotomic character.
Constructs the etale Tate module of an abelian scheme and its functorial local system.
Relates Tate modules to conductors and local Euler polynomials via Neron-Ogg-Shafarevich.

AutomorphicGaloisRepresentations.summary: Nothing in this roadmap exists in the libraries. What they have is the analytic and Hecke side of classical modular forms: Tau Ceti's integral Hecke rings acting on cusp forms with nebentypus, newforms with multiplicity one and strong multiplicity one, the identification of Hecke eigenvalues with q-expansion coefficients, and Mathlib's Hecke bound O(n^(k/2)); Mathlib also defines totally real and CM fields and the period rings B_dR^+ and B_dR. Genuinely missing: modular curves and their Jacobians as schemes, Kuga-Sato varieties, etale cohomology with local systems, the Eichler-Shimura relation, Deligne-Serre, Hilbert modular forms and Shimura curves, Weil-Deligne representations and local Langlands, purity, compatible systems, p-adic Hodge theory beyond the ring definitions, determinant laws over Hecke algebras and the modular abelian varieties A_f.

targets.target: Weight-two Galois representation from the cohomology or Tate module of a modular-curve Jacobian
targets.note: Newforms exist as bundled cusp forms, but modular curves as schemes, their Jacobians and etale cohomology do not.

targets.target: Higher-weight representation from symmetric-power (parabolic) cohomology or Kuga-Sato varieties
targets.note: No Kuga-Sato variety, local system Sym^(k-2) or parabolic cohomology in either library.

targets.target: Hecke projector and two-dimensional eigenspace, with coefficient fields and integral lattices
targets.note: Multiplicity one on complex cusp forms and the Hecke-ring action exist; the eigenspace in Galois cohomology, coefficient fields and lattices do not.

targets.target: Unramified characteristic polynomial X^2 - a_l X + chi(l) l^(k-1) by the Eichler-Shimura relation
targets.note: Only the equality of Hecke eigenvalues with q-expansion coefficients; no Eichler-Shimura congruence relation.

targets.target: Weight-one Artin representation in the Deligne-Serre setting
targets.note: Absent.

duplicates.note: Organizes the Deligne-Serre weight-one Artin representations also constructed here.
Supplies the special-fibre Eichler-Shimura relation that this layer proves for the unramified characteristic polynomial.
The rank-n constructions of AG2.2-AG2.4 produce these rank-two representations again; AG2.7 compares its GL2 special case with R19 by uniqueness.

targets.target: Galois representations of cohomological Hilbert modular forms via Shimura-curve or higher-dimensional cohomology and Jacquet-Langlands transfer
targets.note: Only totally real fields and quaternion algebras exist; there are no Hilbert modular forms, Shimura curves or Jacquet-Langlands.

targets.target: Parity and auxiliary-place cases, including descent from auxiliary totally real fields
targets.note: Absent.

targets.target: Uniqueness, continuity, determinant, oddness and irreducibility of the constructed representations
targets.note: Absent.

duplicates.note: Its regular polarized branch over totally real fields includes rank-two Hilbert modular representations of regular weight, constructed again with uniqueness and determinants.

targets.target: Purity of the eigenform representations from the weight theorem (Ramanujan-Petersson)
targets.note: Mathlib proves only Hecke's bound a_n = O(n^(k/2)); Deligne's bound and Weil purity are absent.

targets.target: Coefficient-independent Frobenius polynomials and the compatible family of a fixed eigenform with its local statements
targets.note: Absent.

targets.target: Separate definitions of weakly, almost strictly and strictly compatible systems
targets.note: No compatible-system notion in either library.

duplicates.note: Builds compatible systems as actual representations with weak, almost strict and strict local predicates kept separate, the same definitions.
Builds a weakly compatible-system object with common Frobenius polynomials and adds purity separately, in rank n.
Deduces eigenspace purity and coefficient-independent bounds for the eigenform realizations.

targets.target: Compatibility of Frobenius-semisimple Weil-Deligne representations with local Langlands away from p, including monodromy and the Steinberg case
targets.note: Neither Weil-Deligne representations nor a local Langlands correspondence exist.

targets.target: Equality of conductors and bad Euler factors
targets.note: Only the Hecke recursion for newform coefficients exists; no Galois conductor or local factor to compare with.

targets.target: Archimedean and automorphic normalisation conventions through the comparison
targets.note: Absent.

duplicates.note: Proves the rank-n good-prime and ramified local-global comparison with Frobenius-semisimplified Weil-Deligne equality retaining N.

targets.target: De Rham, crystalline and potentially semistable properties, Hodge-Tate weights and inertial types at the coefficient prime
targets.note: Mathlib defines B_dR^+ and B_dR only (theta on B_dR^+ and the DVR property are TODO); no admissible representations, Hodge-Tate weights or comparison theorems.

targets.target: Barsotti-Tate, ordinary and endpoint-weight cases needed for lifting
targets.note: Absent.

targets.target: Hypotheses of the local-parameter theorem, keeping almost strict systems distinct from strict ones
targets.note: Absent.

duplicates.note: Owns the application of the crystalline, de Rham and semistable comparison theorems to modular curves, Kuga-Sato varieties and Shimura curves.
Proves the rank-n de Rham, crystalline and semistable coefficient-prime comparison with Hodge-Tate multisets.

targets.target: Determinant law from Hecke operators and Frobenius polynomials
targets.note: The integral Gamma_0(N) Hecke ring acts on complex cusp forms and Mathlib has basic polynomial laws, but there is no Hecke algebra over Z_l, no determinant law and no Galois side.

targets.target: Continuous representation over the localised completed Hecke algebra under absolute residual irreducibility
targets.note: Absent.

targets.target: Compatibility with specialisation, determinant, local type and ramification for the map from a universal deformation ring; nilpotent structure versus reduced specialisations
targets.note: No deformation rings or completed Hecke algebras.

targets.target: V_l(A_f) = direct sum over lambda | l of rho_(f,lambda) for weight two, of total dimension 2[K_f:Q]
targets.note: No modular abelian varieties A_f and no Tate modules.

duplicates.note: Constructs Galois determinants over Hecke algebras by interpolation through finite quotients, with Chebotarev uniqueness.
Proves representability of a determinant by an actual representation over complete local rings under residual absolute irreducibility.
Constructs the Galois determinant and representation over the completed Hecke algebra and the map from the deformation ring, the completed analogue.

AutomorphicGaloisRepresentationsPartII.summary: None of this roadmap exists in Mathlib or Tau Ceti. Distant prerequisites do: Mathlib's untwisted l-adic cohomology of schemes via the pro-etale site, CM and totally real fields, arithmetic Frobenius elements, the cyclotomic character and the period rings B_dR^+ and B_dR; Tau Ceti's classical Hecke rings with Shimura's Theorem 3.20 for GL1 and GL2, Weyl modules (Schur functors), the dominance order on partitions and the adic spectrum Spa. Genuinely missing: automorphic representations of GL_n and their algebraicity and polarization notions, unitary PEL Shimura varieties with Kuga-Sato local systems and commuting Galois-Hecke actions, trace formulas, base change and endoscopy, eigenvarieties, dagger spaces and rigid cohomology, local Langlands and Weil-Deligne representations, p-adic Hodge theory beyond the ring definitions, compatible systems, and lattices with residual comparisons. AG2.1 only aggregates AG2.1a and AG2.1b.

targets.target: Regular algebraic, conjugate self-dual, essentially conjugate self-dual and polarized automorphic representations of GL_n, with multiplier character and coefficient embeddings
targets.note: CM fields exist, but neither library has automorphic representations of GL_n or these algebraicity notions.

targets.target: Rationality of Hecke eigenvalues and finite fields of definition in the proven cohomological cases
targets.note: Not even the classical statement that modular-form Hecke eigenvalues are algebraic integers was found.

targets.target: Normalization dictionary among algebraic weights, arithmetic and geometric Frobenius, cyclotomic twists, normalized Satake and the integral Hecke polynomial
targets.note: Tau Ceti proves the p-local classical Hecke ring of GL_n is a polynomial ring only for n = 1, 2 (Shimura 3.20), with no Satake transform or Hecke polynomial; Mathlib has the pieces for Frobenius and cyclotomic conventions.

targets.target: Agreement of the normalization with rec(pi_v tensor |det|^((1-n)/2)) after local Langlands
targets.note: No local Langlands correspondence.

targets.target: Acceptance examples: algebraic Hecke characters (n = 1), classical modular forms (n = 2), a unitary similitude coefficient
targets.note: Newforms exist on the classical side; algebraic Hecke characters and unitary similitude coefficients do not.

duplicates.note: States the same integral Hecke polynomial with its Satake, determinant, Tate-twist and Frobenius conversions, checked for n = 1, 2.
Proves rationality and finite fields of definition for cohomological cuspidal representations and the algebraic-weight normalizations.

targets.target: Aggregate export of the composed geometric-to-automorphic realization of AG2.1a and AG2.1b (no independent construction)
targets.note: The layer states no mathematics of its own; its content is AG2.1a and AG2.1b, both absent from the libraries.

targets.target: Finite-level etale cohomology of compact PEL unitary/similitude Shimura varieties with the algebraic local system from the universal abelian scheme and its Kuga-Sato powers
targets.note: Mathlib defines untwisted Z_l-cohomology of a scheme on the pro-etale site only; no Shimura varieties, universal abelian schemes, local systems or Galois action.

targets.target: Algebraic correspondences and projectors realizing the Schur functor, Tate twist, parity, degree and field of definition
targets.note: Only Weyl modules (Schur functors of the standard GL_n representation, via Young symmetrizers) exist; no geometric correspondences.

targets.target: Commuting Galois and Hecke actions, finite-dimensionality, continuity and isotypic summands over a coefficient extension
targets.note: Absent.

targets.target: Raw fixed-point and nearby-cycle trace identities for the auxiliary Shimura test functions, without local Langlands
targets.note: No Lefschetz-Fujiwara trace formula or nearby cycles.

targets.target: Relating virtual characters of the cohomology to the geometric trace formula and separating actual representations from alternating classes
targets.note: Absent.

targets.target: Purity, weight separation, multiplicity and cancellation arguments on the Shin route (without torsion concentration)
targets.note: No weights or purity in etale cohomology.

targets.target: Export of the exact semisimple Galois constituent with dimension and Frobenius polynomials
targets.note: Absent.

duplicates.note: Expresses the alternating Igusa cohomology by automorphic representations and separates Hecke eigencharacters with virtual multiplicities retained, the same separation step on the Igusa side.

targets.target: Identification of the GL_n parameter realized in cohomology via stable unitary base change and endoscopic character identities
targets.note: No trace formula, base change or endoscopy.

targets.target: Rank and multiplicity formulas, parity and Shin-regularity restrictions, cuspidal versus discrete isobaric parameters
targets.note: Absent.

targets.target: Representation for each discrete constituent with explicit algebraic twists, and the direct sum with its degree-2n Hecke polynomial
targets.note: Absent.

targets.target: Recovery of the polarization for essentially conjugate self-dual forms, and compatibility with duals, conjugates, character twists and solvable restriction
targets.note: Absent; no polarized Galois representations.

targets.note: Only the adic spectrum Spa(A, A+) as a set of continuous valuations exists; no dagger algebras, rigid cohomology or overconvergent forms.

targets.target: Finite-dimensional slope pieces, independence of neighbourhoods, Hecke action and weight-changing congruences to classical cusp forms

ClassicalSerreModularity.summary: None of the three routes to Serre's conjecture (Khare's level one, Khare-Wintenberger, Dieulefait-Pacetti) has any formal counterpart: neither library has Galois representations attached to modular forms, residual modularity, Serre weights or conductors, compatible systems, modularity lifting, Langlands-Tunnell, Skinner-Wiles, Kisin's dyadic theorem, Schoof's or Fontaine's nonexistence theorems, or good-dihedral primes. The only material the libraries supply is peripheral: Mathlib's Bertrand postulate, explicit Chebyshev bounds and Dirichlet's theorem on primes in progressions (for the prime estimates and auxiliary-prime congruences), Tau Ceti's bundled newforms with strong multiplicity one (the target objects of the classical statement), and Tau Ceti's abelian varieties with dimension. R26.1 is source decomposition rather than mathematics.

targets.target: Source decomposition of Khare's level-one proof, KW Annals 169 section 5.2, and Bockle's appendix, with suppliers assigned for the local lifting, compatible-system and small-prime lemmas
targets.note: Bookkeeping over sources; nothing to find in a library.

targets.target: Statement of the level-one Serre theorem for every residual characteristic with its classical Serre weight, and of Khare's Corollary 1.2 with all hypotheses
targets.note: Newforms exist, but residual Galois representations, residual modularity and Serre weights, needed even to state the theorem, do not.

targets.note: Absent.

CompletedCohomologyAndLocalGlobalCompati.summary: Neither library contains completed cohomology or any piece of the p-adic local-global theory: there are no towers of modular or Shimura curves with their cohomology, no Iwasawa algebras of compact p-adic analytic groups, no admissible Banach or locally algebraic representations, no completed Hecke algebras or deformation rings, no p-adic local Langlands correspondence and no patching. Distant ingredients exist: Mathlib's congruence and arithmetic subgroups, continuous group cohomology, and abstract p-adic measures on Z_p with the Amice transform; Tau Ceti's pro-p groups, classical Hecke rings and newforms. R31.6 is an export and dependency audit rather than new mathematics.

targets.note: Congruence subgroups and continuous group cohomology exist, but no cohomology of modular curves, towers in p-power level, or completion.
